'''Gerhard Abstreiter''' is a [[German physicist]] and professor of physics at [[Technical University of Munich]] (TUM), currently holding the university's highest honor, the Emeritus of Excellence and also being a distinguished visiting professor at [[University of California, Santa Barbara]]. From 1987 to 2015, he was a full professor at TUM and also, in 2010 and 2011, a distinguished visiting professor at [[University of Tokyo]]. He is a Fellow of the [[American Physical Society]], [[Bavarian Academy of Sciences and Humanities]] and [[acatech]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.wsi.tum.de/Portals/0/media/e24/Personal%20Profiles/Abstreiter-CV_selected%20publications_2015.pdf |title=CV |publisher=tum.de |accessdate=December 20, 2016 |archive-date=December 21, 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161221162644/https://www.wsi.tum.de/Portals/0/media/e24/Personal%20Profiles/Abstreiter-CV_selected%20publications_2015.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=dkJ_YqMAAAAJ&hl=en |title=Gerhard Abstreiter |accessdate=December 20, 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.acatech.de/de/ueber-uns/organisation/person.html?acaUid=22796 |title=Gerhard Abstreiter |publisher=acatech.de |accessdate=December 20, 2016 |archive-date=June 24, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170624122737/http://www.acatech.de/de/ueber-uns/organisation/person.html?acaUid=22796 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.worldcat.org/identities/lccn-n97073217/ |title=Abstreiter, Gerhard |publisher=worldcat.org |accessdate=December 20, 2016}}</ref>

He won the [[Max Born Medal and Prize]] in 1998.
